messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Alert: service.us-west.gen p95 latency > 1.2s for 5m. Current error rate normal. paging #oncall @alex. Alert details: https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/5043210000

alex: got it, joining bridge now. Starting initial triage — checking autoscaling and routing.

maria: I can help with KV cache metrics, looks like eviction spikes started ~5m before alert. pulling per-pool cache hit-rate.

alex: quick summary for folks: user-facing generation p95 in us-west jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.3s. throughput ~stable but token latency spikes on long contexts. No broad errors.

jen: are any customers being rate-limited or seeing 5xx? CS tracking top 3 active customers in the region.

alex: no 5xx in logs, some frontend timeouts (30s) for very long requests. Jen please grab customer list and we may send advisory.

maria: KV cache eviction log: 
```
bucket: us-west.pool-3
time: 2026-03-17T10:00:12Z
evictions: spike from 3/min -> 220/min
cause: KV proxy churn during background GC + noisy long-context requests
```

maria: mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily increase KV cache capacity on pool-3, 2) enable aggressive prefix caching for common prompts, 3) route ~15% of traffic to regional fallback model variant (us-west-fallback:v2) to reduce long-token tail.

alex: performing 1) now: bumping cache quota on pool-3 by +25%. Command: `infractl cache update --pool us-west.pool-3 --quota +25%`

ops-bot: runbook step executed: cache quota update triggered by alex at 2026-03-17T10:03:45Z. API response: accepted.

maria: enabling routing diversion for 15% to fallback model: `routingctl route add --from us-west --to us-west-fallback:v2 --percent 15 --reason "latency mitigation"`

ops-bot: routing change applied. New split: us-west -> primary 85%, us-west-fallback:v2 15%.

alex: monitoring p95. If p95 drops under 600ms and error rate stable for 5m, we consider this effective.

maria: early numbers: p95 dropped to ~720ms after cache bump and routing — improvement but still above target. Continuing to observe.

david: drafting status page + customer advisory. Suggest language: short, non-alarming, note mitigations and ETA.

alex: include known impact: increased latency for generation requests in US-WEST for long-context queries. No data loss. We expect recovery window 30–60m depending on cache stabilization.

jen: customer comm template draft: 
```
Subject: Brief service advisory — temporary latency increase in US-WEST
Hi Team,
We're investigating increased latency for generation requests in our US-WEST region. The issue affects long-context generation requests and may cause slower responses. Our engineers have applied mitigations including cache capacity increases and partial traffic diversion; we expect further improvement over the next 30–60 minutes. No customer data was lost. We'll follow up with a status update in 30 minutes.

If you see critical customer impact, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize direct outreach.
Thanks, Redwood Inference Ops
```

maria: additional note: if p95 doesn't improve to <600ms in 20m, plan B is to scale up dedicated GPU pool for the impacted host group by +1 node and increase token batching thresholds to reduce per-token compute overhead.

alex: ack. Adding to runbook: `incident -> escalate -> scale + adjust batching`.

ops-bot: metric checkpoint: 2m after routing change: p95=680ms, p50=210ms, total tokens/sec unchanged.

alex: good. jen please hold off public status update until next checkpoint. We'll post a brief Status Page entry once we confirm sustained improvement or execute plan B.

jen: copying the draft to the status page editor and standing by.

maria: also found a noisy client doing many long-context replays; I've applied short-term per-client throttling to reduce churn. Monitored impact looks positive.

alex: summary/handoff for next oncall: we bumped cache quota, diverted 15% traffic to fallback variant, applied per-client throttling for noisy consumer, draft customer advisory ready. Monitor p95 and errors; if p95 > 900ms persist for 10m escalate to infra scaling. Handoff pinned in bridge.

david: FYI product teams — tracking possible regression signal from a recent model change in us-west rollouts; follow-up eval running.

jen: posting status page now: short message + link to this thread for internal details. Will notify customers flagged as high-touch.

ops-bot: status page update posted at 2026-03-17T10:18:03Z. URL: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/5043210000

alex: closing bridge in 30m or earlier if resolved. Leaving handoff note in pager: next oncall please pick up if p95 > 900ms or errors > 0.5% for 10m.

maria: final checkpoint 30m: p95 stabilized ~520ms, no increase in error rate. Recommend we keep routing diversion at 15% for 1 hour then gradually pull back.

alex: thanks all — marking incident as mitigated. Will follow up with post-incident notes and RCA if model rollout is implicated.
